legalTerms.p1: By using the Janat Sahara Travel website, you accept these terms. The information provided during booking must be accurate and complete.
legalTerms.p2: No payment is made through the website. The booking and payment are confirmed directly with our team, by phone, WhatsApp, or at the nearest branch.
legalTerms.p3: We reserve the right to modify rates or itineraries based on our partners' availability. You will be informed of any changes before your booking is finally confirmed.

legalPrivacy.p1: At Janat Sahara Travel, we are committed to protecting your privacy. The data you provide is used only to confirm your bookings and communicate with you about your trip.
legalPrivacy.p2: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.
legalPrivacy.p3: Passports and travel documents are kept in secure storage, accessible only to authorized team members.
